answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A quill of per-task receipts records who did what, and the knoll of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
